ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.subagents.role: counted noun phrase inside the running clause
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.subagents.tone: plain noun phrase, lower case, no verb
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.subagents.note: Sidebar conversation row: appended once, after a ' · ' separator, to the row's hover tooltip and its screen-reader sentence when the session's own turn has ended (or is live) but it still has subagents, background jobs or waits running. Never a standalone heading. Joined with the jobs phrase by the locale's list formatter (Intl.ListFormat unit/short) and then placed into {items} of ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.running; must read as a noun phrase, without a verb.

ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.jobs.role: counted noun phrase inside the running clause
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.jobs.tone: plain noun phrase, lower case, no verb
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.jobs.note: Sidebar conversation row: appended once, after a ' · ' separator, to the row's hover tooltip and its screen-reader sentence when the session's own turn has ended (or is live) but it still has subagents, background jobs or waits running. Never a standalone heading. A job is a background shell/process job the agent started. Joined with the subagents phrase by the locale's list formatter and placed into {items} of ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.running; must read as a noun phrase, without a verb.

ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.running.role: clause saying listed work is still running
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.running.tone: status phrase, sentence fragment, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.running.note: Sidebar conversation row: appended once, after a ' · ' separator, to the row's hover tooltip and its screen-reader sentence when the session's own turn has ended (or is live) but it still has subagents, background jobs or waits running. Never a standalone heading. English example: '1 subagent, 1 job running'. {items} is an already-localized list of counted noun phrases; word order may move it.

placeholders.items: localized list such as '1 subagent, 1 job'

ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.queued.role: count of queued subagents after a running clause
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.queued.note: Sidebar conversation row: appended once, after a ' · ' separator, to the row's hover tooltip and its screen-reader sentence when the session's own turn has ended (or is live) but it still has subagents, background jobs or waits running. Never a standalone heading. Follows a running clause after ' · ', so the noun is elided as in English '2 subagents running · 1 queued'.

ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.subagents_queued.role: count of queued subagents when nothing is running
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.subagents_queued.note: Sidebar conversation row: appended once, after a ' · ' separator, to the row's hover tooltip and its screen-reader sentence when the session's own turn has ended (or is live) but it still has subagents, background jobs or waits running. Never a standalone heading. Used alone when no subagent or job is running yet: '2 subagents queued'.

ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.waiting.role: clause when the only background fact is an armed wait
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.waiting.tone: status phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.row.bg.waiting.note: Sidebar conversation row: appended once, after a ' · ' separator, to the row's hover tooltip and its screen-reader sentence when the session's own turn has ended (or is live) but it still has subagents, background jobs or waits running. Never a standalone heading. Used only when the session is waiting on background work and nothing is counted as running or queued.
